integrity: A complete mathematical argument and an independently implemented small-instance checker accompany the claim; computational tests do not replace the all-size proof. This report is self-reviewed, not independently audited.
limitations: Only full nonzero finite Boolean powersets with intersection accessibility; does not cover induced subframes, infinite carriers, or restricted atomic-valuation model morphisms. A potentially equivalent unindexed theorem remains possible.
title: Bounded morphisms between finite Boolean compatibility frames are precisely atom surjections
